help_sections.title: Collection
help_sections.body:
`!add <name>` / `/add character:` add via reviewed catalog/provider selection.
`!remove <character>` remove; `!undo` restore.
`!move <character> <position>` reorder.
`!profile [@user] [position]` browse; example `!profile 5`.
`!random`, `!compare @user`, `!export`.

help_sections.title: Search
help_sections.body:
`!p <query>` text search; `!sp <query>` visual search.
`!sa <work>` / `!sap <work>` select a production, then browse characters.
`!find [@user] <query>` searches names, aliases, nicknames, and works.

help_sections.title: Images and notes
help_sections.body:
`!pi <character> <URL>` or attachment submits an image for review.
`!images`, `!pic <n>`, `!piremove <n>`, `!pireset`. Slash: `/image add|list|select|remove|reset`.
`!nick`, `!unnick`, `!note`, `!unnote`.

help_sections.title: Appearance and utilities
help_sections.body:
`!avatar`, `!banner` submit reviewed appearance images; slash `/settings avatar|banner`.
`!bio`, `!title`, `!color`, `!language`, `!settings`, `!reset`.
`!custom`, `!editcustom`, `!report`, `!help`.

help_admin_body: `!setup #channel`; `!channel add|remove|list|all`. Slash equivalents use `/setup` and `/channel`. Significant changes require confirmation.
